messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["not known whether passes into breast milk", "passes into breast milk", "pass into breast milk", "breast milk", "metformin can pass into breast milk", "medicines can pass into breast milk and may harm baby", "may slow breast milk production", "not known", "breast milk in small amounts", "breast milk in low amounts", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk", "breast growth", "breast tenderness", "milk production", "heart disease is not always known about", "relieves muscle spasm whether or not sedation occurs"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
